verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is an open-source (MIT) rendering engine distributed as NPM/ES6 modules that developers include and run entirely within their own apps/servers — the probe confirms it's described as an 'open game and rendering engine', and docs cover server-side execution (NullEngine, serverSide support) enabling headless/self-hosted use with no vendor cloud dependency. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting guide/deployment tutorial and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of running the full engine server-side in production.
